verdict.rationale: An official CLI is a fair question for an observability platform, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack documents an official Elastic Observability CLI. The closest items are the Elastic Agent install/Fleet management, which is a data-collection agent rather than a user-facing CLI, and the ES|QL REST API, which is a developer building block; neither counts toward this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can use an official CLI
